items.name: AnyDesk
items.description: Remote desktop for attended support sessions.
items.description_id: Desktop jarak jauh untuk sesi dukungan terdampingi.
use_cases: Help a user remotely.
use_cases_id: Membantu pengguna dari jarak jauh.
cautions: Only accept a session you expected, from a person you identified; remote-support tools are a common scam vector.
cautions_id: Terima hanya sesi yang Anda harapkan dari orang yang telah Anda identifikasi; alat dukungan jarak jauh sering dipakai untuk penipuan.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Autoruns
items.description: Lists everything that starts with Windows: startup entries, services, drivers, scheduled tasks and more.
items.description_id: Mendaftar semua yang berjalan saat Windows mulai: entri startup, layanan, driver, tugas terjadwal, dan lainnya.
use_cases: Find what slows boot or keeps re-launching after cleanup.
use_cases_id: Menemukan penyebab boot lambat atau program yang terus muncul setelah dibersihkan.
cautions: Disabling the wrong entry can stop Windows or a driver from loading; change one thing at a time.
cautions_id: Menonaktifkan entri yang salah dapat menghentikan Windows atau driver dimuat; ubah satu hal setiap kali.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: balenaEtcher
items.description: Writes OS images to USB drives and SD cards with a verification step.
items.description_id: Menulis citra OS ke drive USB dan kartu SD dengan langkah verifikasi.
use_cases: Flash Linux images or single-board-computer cards.
use_cases_id: Menulis citra Linux atau kartu untuk komputer papan tunggal.
cautions: Erases the target device.
cautions_id: Menghapus perangkat target.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: CPUID CPU-Z
items.description: Reports the CPU, motherboard, memory modules and graphics adapter in a compact view.
items.description_id: Melaporkan CPU, motherboard, modul memori, dan adapter grafis dalam tampilan ringkas.
use_cases: Check RAM speed and slots before an upgrade.
Confirm the CPU model reported by the system.
use_cases_id: Periksa kecepatan dan slot RAM sebelum upgrade.
Pastikan model CPU yang dilaporkan sistem.
cautions: Information comes from the firmware and drivers; a faulty report can itself be a symptom.
cautions_id: Informasi berasal dari firmware dan driver; laporan yang janggal bisa menjadi gejala.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: CrystalDiskInfo
items.description: Shows the health, temperature and SMART attributes of supported storage devices.
items.description_id: Menampilkan kesehatan, suhu, dan atribut SMART perangkat penyimpanan yang didukung.
use_cases: Check a disk before reinstalling Windows or cloning it.
Spot reallocated or pending sectors that predict a failing drive.
use_cases_id: Periksa disk sebelum menginstal ulang Windows atau mengkloning.
Temukan sektor realokasi atau tertunda yang menandakan drive akan rusak.
cautions: A "Good" status is not a guarantee; back up anything important regardless.
Some USB enclosures hide SMART data from the host.
cautions_id: Status "Good" bukan jaminan; tetap cadangkan data penting.
Beberapa casing USB menyembunyikan data SMART dari host.
items.notes: Check the package, bundled offers and compatibility before distributing it.
items.notes_id: Periksa paket, iklan bundel, dan kompatibilitas sebelum mendistribusikan.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: CrystalDiskMark
items.description: Measures sequential and random read/write speed of drives.
items.description_id: Mengukur kecepatan baca/tulis sekuensial dan acak pada drive.
use_cases: Confirm a new SSD performs as expected.
Compare a suspect drive against a known-good one.
use_cases_id: Pastikan SSD baru berkinerja sesuai harapan.
Bandingkan drive yang dicurigai dengan drive yang baik.
cautions: Write tests wear flash storage a little and fill free space; do not run them on a drive that holds data you cannot lose without a backup.
cautions_id: Uji tulis sedikit menggerus penyimpanan flash dan memakai ruang kosong; jangan jalankan pada drive berisi data penting tanpa cadangan.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Display Driver Uninstaller
items.description: Removes graphics driver leftovers when a normal uninstall fails.
items.description_id: Menghapus sisa driver grafis ketika uninstall biasa gagal.
use_cases: Clean up before installing a different GPU vendor's driver.
use_cases_id: Membersihkan sebelum memasang driver dari vendor GPU lain.
cautions: Create a restore point and use it only when a regular uninstall has failed.
Tool authors recommend running it from Safe Mode; read its documentation first.
cautions_id: Buat titik pemulihan dan gunakan hanya bila uninstall biasa gagal.
Pembuat alat menyarankan menjalankannya dari Safe Mode; baca dokumentasinya terlebih dahulu.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Hiren's BootCD PE
items.description: A Windows PE rescue disc with many diagnostic and recovery tools in one ISO.
items.description_id: Cakram penyelamat Windows PE dengan banyak alat diagnostik dan pemulihan dalam satu ISO.
use_cases: Reset a lost Windows login, rescue files or test disks on a PC that will not boot.
use_cases_id: Mengatur ulang login Windows yang hilang, menyelamatkan berkas, atau menguji disk pada PC yang tidak mau boot.
cautions: It bundles third-party tools with their own licenses; some are trial or commercial.
Only use it on machines you are authorised to repair.
cautions_id: Memuat alat pihak ketiga dengan lisensinya masing-masing; sebagian trial atau komersial.
Hanya gunakan pada mesin yang Anda berwenang memperbaikinya.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: HWiNFO
items.description: Detailed hardware inventory and live sensor readings (temperatures, voltages, fan speeds).
items.description_id: Inventaris perangkat keras terperinci dan pembacaan sensor langsung (suhu, tegangan, kecepatan kipas).
use_cases: Identify exactly which components are in a PC, including chipset and Wi-Fi model.
Log temperatures while reproducing a crash.
use_cases_id: Identifikasi komponen persis di sebuah PC, termasuk chipset dan model Wi-Fi.
Catat suhu saat mereproduksi crash.
cautions: Sensor access may need administrator rights.
cautions_id: Akses sensor mungkin memerlukan hak administrator.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Intel® Driver & Support Assistant
items.description: Intel's detection tool for Intel hardware drivers and software.
items.description_id: Alat deteksi Intel untuk driver dan perangkat lunak perangkat keras Intel.
use_cases: Find out which Intel driver updates exist for a PC.
use_cases_id: Mengetahui pembaruan driver Intel apa yang tersedia untuk sebuah PC.
cautions: Intel notes that your computer maker may have customised the driver; check the maker first on branded laptops.
cautions_id: Intel mencatat bahwa pabrikan komputer mungkin telah menyesuaikan driver; periksa pabrikan terlebih dahulu pada laptop bermerek.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: LibreHardwareMonitor
items.description: Open-source hardware monitor for temperatures, fan speeds, voltages, load and clock speeds.
items.description_id: Pemantau perangkat keras open source untuk suhu, kecepatan kipas, tegangan, beban, dan clock.
use_cases: Lightweight alternative when you only need sensor values.
use_cases_id: Alternatif ringan ketika hanya perlu nilai sensor.
cautions: Needs administrator rights for some sensors.
cautions_id: Memerlukan hak administrator untuk beberapa sensor.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: MemTest86 (Free edition)
items.description: PassMark RAM tester that boots from a USB drive (UEFI).
items.description_id: Penguji RAM PassMark yang boot dari drive USB (UEFI).
use_cases: Alternative second opinion when Memtest86+ reports nothing but memory is still suspected.
use_cases_id: Pendapat kedua ketika Memtest86+ tidak melaporkan apa pun tetapi memori tetap dicurigai.
cautions: The Free edition is feature-limited; version 11.7 boots on UEFI firmware only, per the vendor page.
cautions_id: Edisi Free memiliki fitur terbatas; versi 11.7 hanya boot pada firmware UEFI, menurut halaman vendor.
items.notes: Check the free/paid edition and the official instructions before use.
items.notes_id: Periksa edisi gratis/berbayar dan petunjuk resmi sebelum penggunaan.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Memtest86+
items.description: Open-source RAM tester that boots from USB or CD, outside Windows.
items.description_id: Penguji RAM open source yang boot dari USB atau CD, di luar Windows.
use_cases: Find faulty memory when a PC crashes or shows random blue screens.
Test new RAM before putting a system into service.
use_cases_id: Menemukan memori rusak ketika PC crash atau sering blue screen.
Menguji RAM baru sebelum sistem dipakai.
cautions: Run at least one full pass; an error-free partial run proves little.
The project says Secure Boot must be disabled temporarily to boot it.
cautions_id: Jalankan setidaknya satu pass penuh; uji parsial tanpa error tidak membuktikan banyak.
Proyek menyatakan Secure Boot perlu dinonaktifkan sementara agar dapat boot.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Nmap
items.description: Network scanner for discovering hosts and open ports.
items.description_id: Pemindai jaringan untuk menemukan host dan port terbuka.
use_cases: Check what a device exposes on the network.
use_cases_id: Memeriksa apa yang dibuka sebuah perangkat di jaringan.
cautions: Scan only hosts and networks you own or are authorised to test.
cautions_id: Pindai hanya host dan jaringan milik Anda atau yang Anda berwenang mengujinya.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: OCCT
items.description: Stress tests for CPU, memory, GPU and power supply to expose instability.
items.description_id: Uji stres untuk CPU, memori, GPU, dan catu daya guna mengungkap ketidakstabilan.
use_cases: Reproduce random crashes or reboots under load.
Validate a PC after an overclock or hardware swap.
use_cases_id: Mereproduksi crash atau reboot acak saat beban.
Validasi PC setelah overclock atau penggantian perangkat keras.
cautions: Stress tests push hardware to its limits; watch temperatures and stop if they climb.
cautions_id: Uji stres mendorong perangkat keras ke batasnya; pantau suhu dan hentikan bila naik.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Process Explorer
items.description: An advanced Task Manager: process tree, handles, DLLs and signature checks.
items.description_id: Task Manager tingkat lanjut: pohon proses, handle, DLL, dan pemeriksaan tanda tangan.
use_cases: See which process holds a file open or uses CPU.
use_cases_id: Melihat proses mana yang menahan berkas terbuka atau memakai CPU.
cautions: Killing system processes can crash Windows.
cautions_id: Menghentikan proses sistem dapat membuat Windows crash.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Process Monitor
items.description: Live view of file system, registry and process/thread activity.
items.description_id: Tampilan langsung aktivitas sistem berkas, registri, dan proses/thread.
use_cases: Find what a failing program is trying to open.
use_cases_id: Menemukan apa yang coba dibuka oleh program yang gagal.
cautions: Captures a lot of data quickly; use filters and stop the capture when done. Logs may contain private paths.
cautions_id: Menangkap banyak data dengan cepat; gunakan filter dan hentikan penangkapan bila selesai. Log dapat memuat jalur privat.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Rufus
items.description: Creates bootable USB drives from ISO images (Windows installers, Linux, rescue tools).
items.description_id: Membuat drive USB bootable dari citra ISO (penginstal Windows, Linux, alat penyelamat).
use_cases: Make a Windows installation USB.
Boot a rescue ISO on a machine without a working OS.
use_cases_id: Membuat USB instalasi Windows.
Boot ISO penyelamat pada mesin tanpa OS yang berfungsi.
cautions: The selected USB drive is erased; double-check the device letter.
Verify the ISO's checksum against the publisher's value first.
cautions_id: Drive USB yang dipilih akan dihapus; periksa ulang huruf drive.
Verifikasi checksum ISO dengan nilai dari penerbit terlebih dahulu.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: smartmontools
items.description: Command-line SMART monitoring and self-tests for ATA/SATA and NVMe drives.
items.description_id: Pemantauan SMART dan uji mandiri via baris perintah untuk drive ATA/SATA dan NVMe.
use_cases: Script health checks across several machines.
Start a long SMART self-test and read the result later.
use_cases_id: Buat skrip pemeriksaan kesehatan di banyak komputer.
Mulai uji mandiri SMART panjang dan baca hasilnya nanti.
cautions: Run from an elevated prompt; interpreting raw attributes needs care because vendors differ.
cautions_id: Jalankan dari prompt yang ditinggikan; menafsirkan atribut mentah perlu hati-hati karena vendor berbeda.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Sysinternals Suite
items.description: Microsoft's troubleshooting utilities (Process Explorer, Autoruns, PsTools, Sysmon and more) in one ZIP.
items.description_id: Utilitas pemecahan masalah Microsoft (Process Explorer, Autoruns, PsTools, Sysmon, dan lainnya) dalam satu ZIP.
use_cases: Carry a portable toolbox on a USB stick for on-site diagnosis.
use_cases_id: Membawa perangkat portabel di USB untuk diagnosis di lokasi.
cautions: Several tools show or change system internals; learn what a tool does before running it on a production PC.
cautions_id: Beberapa alat menampilkan atau mengubah bagian dalam sistem; pelajari fungsi alat sebelum menjalankannya di PC produksi.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: TeamViewer
items.description: Remote support and access tool.
items.description_id: Alat dukungan dan akses jarak jauh.
use_cases: Help a user remotely.
use_cases_id: Membantu pengguna dari jarak jauh.
cautions: Check the license terms: personal-use editions are not meant for commercial support.
Only accept sessions you expected.
cautions_id: Periksa ketentuan lisensi: edisi penggunaan pribadi tidak ditujukan untuk dukungan komersial.
Terima hanya sesi yang Anda harapkan.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: TechPowerUp GPU-Z
items.description: Shows graphics card details and sensor data.
items.description_id: Menampilkan detail kartu grafis dan data sensor.
use_cases: Confirm the actual GPU model and driver version.
Watch GPU temperature and clocks under load.
use_cases_id: Pastikan model GPU dan versi driver yang sebenarnya.
Pantau suhu dan clock GPU saat beban.
cautions: Cards sold as relabelled or counterfeit models can report misleading names; compare with the physical card.
cautions_id: Kartu yang dilabeli ulang atau palsu dapat melaporkan nama menyesatkan; bandingkan dengan kartu fisiknya.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: TestDisk
items.description: Recovers lost partitions and repairs boot sectors; includes PhotoRec for deleted files.
items.description_id: Memulihkan partisi yang hilang dan memperbaiki boot sector; menyertakan PhotoRec untuk berkas terhapus.
use_cases: Recover a partition table after a bad repartition.
Recover deleted photos and documents from a card or disk.
use_cases_id: Memulihkan tabel partisi setelah partisi ulang yang salah.
Memulihkan foto dan dokumen terhapus dari kartu atau disk.
cautions: Stop using the affected drive first and write recovered files to a different disk.
Prefer working on a clone of a failing drive.
cautions_id: Hentikan pemakaian drive terdampak terlebih dahulu dan tulis berkas hasil pemulihan ke disk lain.
Sebaiknya bekerja pada klon dari drive yang rusak.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Ventoy
items.description: Turns a USB drive into a multi-boot stick: copy ISO files onto it and pick one at boot.
items.description_id: Mengubah drive USB menjadi stik multi-boot: salin berkas ISO ke dalamnya dan pilih saat boot.
use_cases: Carry several installers and rescue disks on one drive.
use_cases_id: Membawa beberapa penginstal dan cakram penyelamat dalam satu drive.
cautions: Installing Ventoy erases the USB drive.
Secure Boot needs extra steps; read the project documentation.
cautions_id: Memasang Ventoy menghapus drive USB.
Secure Boot memerlukan langkah tambahan; baca dokumentasi proyek.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: Wireshark
items.description: Packet capture and protocol analyser for network troubleshooting.
items.description_id: Penangkap paket dan penganalisis protokol untuk pemecahan masalah jaringan.
use_cases: See why a connection stalls or what a device is sending.
use_cases_id: Melihat penyebab koneksi macet atau apa yang dikirim sebuah perangkat.
cautions: Capture only networks you are authorised to monitor; captures can contain private data.
cautions_id: Tangkap hanya jaringan yang Anda berwenang memantaunya; hasil tangkapan dapat memuat data privat.

sources.note: Use cases and cautions are general technician practice written by the maintainers; install options and versions come from the linked app record.

items.name: WizTree
items.description: Very fast disk space analyser that shows which folders and files take the space.
items.description_id: Penganalisis ruang disk yang sangat cepat untuk melihat folder dan berkas yang memakan ruang.
use_cases: Explain a full C: drive in seconds.
use_cases_id: Menjelaskan drive C: yang penuh dalam hitungan detik.
cautions: Check a file's purpose before deleting; system folders can be large for a reason.
cautions_id: Periksa fungsi berkas sebelum menghapus; folder sistem bisa besar karena suatu alasan.
